edition.title: NPNF Second Series, Volume IX: Hilary of Poitiers, John of Damascus

alternate_titles: Hilary of Poitiers, John of Damascus
work.author: Philip Schaff and Henry Wace
work.description: The ninth volume of the second series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Hilary of Poitiers on the Trinity and John of Damascus, including An Exact Exposition of the Orthodox Faith, in English, with the volume editors' introductions. Its container identity remains distinct from the individual authors' works printed within it.
work.title: A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Volume IX
